- Conftructo & firmato hoc nido, pabulato-

page.notes: Right-margin notes are partly illegible; "Iefuitarum in Aulu pofulata" and "Iefuitarū se- nales" are doubtful readings. The page is partly damaged at the lower right; the last line is cut at the edge of the scan and ends with "facilius" where the text may continue. Printing errors and abbreviations are kept as printed where legible, and some words in the first paragraph are uncertain.
